name: Tenkishi Orc ni Kudaru.
source:
A demonic force has arisen from below to conquer the human race.
Since human society was exhausted due to the civil war, they were helpless against the evil hordes...
Opposed to the heaven's policy of non-intervention, a legion of celestial world comes down to assist humanity.

While they may have taken female human's appearance, they have godly powers to defeat the demonic forces.
After the war, they became worshiped as the "Three Celestial Knightesses".
But... after a while, these Knightesses abruptly disappear.

This is because the higher beings of the celestial world punished them for their disregard of the nonintervention policy.
It seems like they vanished deep into the darkness of the history...
However, they are still alive. Their dragonic origin protecting them from death, these celestial beings are immortal... Even if they were to wish otherwise...

One of the Three Celestial Knightesses, Hilde, arrives at a village which is being seriously threatened by an army of orcs...
translation:
一股恶魔力量从地下崛起，企图征服人类。

人类社会因内战而疲惫不堪，面对邪恶大军毫无还手之力……

反对天界不干涉政策的天界军团降临，协助人类。

她们虽然采取人类女性外表，却拥有击败恶魔势力的神力。战争结束后，她们被人们尊为“三位天界女骑士”。

然而……过了一段时间，这些骑士突然消失了。

原来，天界的高位存在因她们无视不干涉政策而惩罚了她们。她们似乎就此消失在历史深处……

但她们仍然活着。龙族血统使她们免于死亡，这些天界存在是不死的……即使她们自己希望死亡也一样。

三位天界女骑士之一希尔德，来到了一个正受到兽人大军严重威胁的村庄。
